title: AI Cover Letter Builder & Multi-Format Generator 10/10 Overhaul (Google M3 / Cuba Executive Token Harmonization & ATS Keyword Matching)
spec:
# DIR-014: AI Cover Letter Builder & Multi-Format Generator 10/10 Overhaul

## 1. Executive Context & Objectives
The AI Cover Letter Builder (`src/components/CoverLetter/CoverLetter.jsx` and `src/components/CoverLetter/CoverLetter.scss`) is a core candidate workspace feature that lets job seekers generate, customize, format, preview, and export targeted cover letters across 4 distinct visual templates with multi-tone AI synthesis and real-time ATS keyword matching.

Currently, `CoverLetter.jsx` (1,663 lines) uses legacy Tailwind utility classes (`bg-white`, `bg-slate-50`, `border-slate-200`, `text-indigo-600`), raw hex colors in `CoverLetter.scss`, has duplicate header branding when viewed in `/dashboard/cover-letters` within `CubaCandidateShell`, and lacks full Cuba Executive dark mode support and dedicated E2E verification.

This directive mandates a complete 10/10 architectural overhaul of `CoverLetter.jsx` and `CoverLetter.scss`, integrating seamlessly with the Cuba Executive design system (`--cuba-*`), harmonizing with `CubaCandidateShell`, enhancing ATS keyword matching, and locking quality with a dedicated Playwright E2E suite (`playwright.dir014.config.js`).

## 2. Key Architecture Directives
1. **Design System & Token Harmonization**:
   - Replace all legacy `bg-slate-50`, `bg-white`, `border-slate-200`, `text-indigo-600`, etc. with standard Cuba Executive CSS variables:
     - Backgrounds: `var(--cuba-bg-primary)`, `var(--cuba-card-bg)`, `var(--cuba-surface)`
     - Borders: `var(--cuba-border)`, `var(--cuba-border-subtle)`
     - Typography: `var(--cuba-ink-primary)`, `var(--cuba-ink-secondary)`, `var(--cuba-ink-muted)`
     - Accents & Buttons: `.cuba-btn-primary`, `.cuba-btn-secondary`, `.cuba-btn-outline`, `.cuba-fill-pill`
     - Inputs: Themed input fields with `--cuba-focus-ring` focus indicators.
   - Ensure full dark mode responsiveness without text-contrast inversion issues.

2. **Shell Encapsulation & Header De-duplication**:
   - Detect whether component is mounted inside `CubaCandidateShell` (e.g. pathname `/dashboard/cover-letters` or via prop).
   - When inside the candidate shell, suppress redundant header banner/logo (`logo.png`) and "Back to Dashboard" button, aligning with the standard page title and breadcrumb pattern used in other candidate modules.
   - When accessed standalone via `/coverletter`, provide a clean Cuba header card.

3. **Template Renderer & Zoomable In-Modal Preview**:
   - Retain full functionality for all 4 cover letter templates (`Cover1`, `Cover2`, `Cover3`, `Cover4`).
   - Elevate the visual preview frame and in-modal zoom controls (0.5x, 0.75x, 1.0x, 1.25x) with smooth CSS transforms and Escape-key dismiss.
   - Preserve A4 print media query isolation in `CoverLetter.scss`.

4. **Interactive ATS Keyword Match Meter**:
   - Polish the ATS match calculation with a prominent Cuba-styled circular or linear score indicator:
     - >= 80%: Emerald / Success tier
     - 60-79%: Amber / Warning tier
     - < 60%: Red / Critical tier
   - Render matched keyword badges in emerald pills and missing keyword badges in amber/slate pills.
   - Add 1-click action to copy or insert missing keywords into the editor.

5. **Cloud Persistence & Job Tracker Integration**:
   - Preserve authentic MariaDB CRUD via `saveCoverLetter`, `getUserCoverLetters`, `deleteCoverLetter`, and `createTrackedJob`.
   - Never inject mock data or synthetic local fallback arrays.

6. **Dedicated Playwright E2E Suite**:
   - Create `playwright.dir014.config.js` targeting `tests/e2e/dir014-cover-letter.spec.js`.
   - Execute against the live running stack (`http://localhost:3000`).
   - Validate token resolution, step navigation, template selection, ATS computation, and modal preview.
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).
INV-2: Zero Token & Credential Leakage: No plain text API keys, secrets, or internal auth tokens rendered in DOM or client logs.
INV-3: WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility: Contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 across light and dark modes, explicit landmark/nav labelling, and keyboard focusable controls.

INV-4: Authentic MariaDB Persistence: All saved cover letters, edits, and deletions must communicate exclusively through authenticated platform API (saveCoverLetter, getUserCoverLetters, deleteCoverLetter, createTrackedJob) with ZERO mock arrays or synthetic local state overrides.
INV-5: Performance Budget: Vite production build must complete in < 4.0s with 0 ESLint errors; sub-100ms UI render latency.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Tokenize CoverLetter.jsx & CoverLetter.scss: Replace all hardcoded Tailwind slate/indigo utilities and raw hex colors with semantic Cuba Executive design tokens (--cuba-bg-primary, --cuba-card-bg, --cuba-border, --cuba-ink-primary, --cuba-ink-muted, .cuba-btn-primary, .cuba-btn-secondary, .cuba-fill-pill, etc.), with full dark mode support.

AC-2: Seamless Candidate Shell & Header Integration: When mounted inside Candidate Dashboard (/dashboard/cover-letters), eliminate duplicate header card/logo chrome and blend harmoniously into CubaCandidateShell; when mounted standalone (/coverletter), render clean Cuba AppHeader and responsive container.

AC-3: Stepper & View Mode Elevation: Step 1 (Candidate Profile & Target Role), Step 2 (AI Generator & Template Selector), and Step 3 (Export & Multi-Channel Package) elevated to Cuba M3 styled cards with responsive transitions and accessible aria attributes.

AC-4: 4 Cover Letter Templates & In-Modal Multi-Format Preview: Cover1 (Executive Classic), Cover2 (Modern Left-Aligned), Cover3 (Split Sidebar), Cover4 (Accent Icons) render cleanly via TemplateRenderer with visual/text toggle, modal zoom in/out controls (0.5x to 1.5x), and Escape-key dismiss.

AC-5: Real-Time ATS Keyword Match Meter & Badges: Interactive ATS score meter (0-100%) dynamically updating upon Job Description input, rendering matched vs missing keyword chips, with 1-click insertion or copy of missing keywords.

AC-6: Multi-Tone AI Generation & Job Tracker Sync: Support all 4 AI tone archetypes (Modern Professional, Executive Formal, Impact & Metrics, Creative Storyteller), non-blocking AbortController lifecycle, and 1-click sync to Job Tracker (createTrackedJob).

AC-7: Multi-Channel Export Suite & Print Isolation: High-fidelity TXT export, formatted clipboard copy, WhatsApp, Email, Telegram, and LinkedIn sharing; strict A4 print media query in CoverLetter.scss isolating .cover-letter-print-document without screen artifacts.

AC-8: Comprehensive Playwright E2E Suite (playwright.dir014.config.js & tests/e2e/dir014-cover-letter.spec.js): 100% passing tests against live dev server verifying Cuba token resolution, stepper navigation, template switching, ATS match calculation, persistence CRUD, and modal zoom.
AC-9: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test zero regressions.

plan.summary: DIR-014 audit complete. CRITICAL FINDING: every token name in the directive spec is NON-EXISTENT in the authoritative src/styles/cuba-tokens.css. Mapping to real canonical tokens (DIR-013 precedent): --cuba-bg-primary->--cuba-canvas, --cuba-card-bg->--cuba-card, --cuba-surface->--cuba-elevated, --cuba-border->--cuba-line, --cuba-border-subtle->--cuba-line, --cuba-ink-primary->--cuba-ink, --cuba-ink-secondary->--cuba-ink-muted, --cuba-ink-muted->--cuba-ink-subtle, --cuba-focus-ring->--cuba-primary-ring + .cuba-focus-ring class (all three named primitives .cuba-btn-primary/.cuba-btn-outline/.cuba-fill-pill DO exist). Plan: (1) author semantic cl-* SCSS layer in CoverLetter.scss consuming only real --cuba-* tokens, converting all ~200 legacy Tailwind slate/indigo utilities; (2) shell encapsulation via withRouter pathname gate (/dashboard/* -> suppress logo+Back to Dashboard chrome; standalone /coverletter -> clean Cuba header card); (3) M3 stepper + ATS tier meter (>=80 emerald/60-79 amber/<60 red) with 1-click keyword insertion; (4) zoom steps 0.5-1.5x; (5) A4 @media print isolation preserved verbatim; (6) playwright.dir014.config.js + tests/e2e/dir014-cover-letter.spec.js against live :3000 with zero API mocking. Stack pre-verified: Vite :3000=200, Backend :8080=200 (MariaDB UP/NORMAL/writable), frozen diff e314f715 = 0 bytes.

reviews.feedback:
Senior Engineering Lead Review: PLAN APPROVED.

1. Token Mapping Concurrence:
   - Your audit of src/styles/cuba-tokens.css is 100% accurate. Canonical mapping (--cuba-canvas, --cuba-card, --cuba-elevated, --cuba-line, --cuba-ink, --cuba-ink-muted, --cuba-ink-subtle, --cuba-primary-ring, .cuba-btn-primary, .cuba-btn-outline, .cuba-fill-pill) is fully endorsed.
   - The semantic cl-* class layer in CoverLetter.scss backed by these canonical tokens ensures clean separation, effortless dark mode support, and zero raw hex leakage outside @media print.

2. Shell Encapsulation & Header De-duplication:
   - Pathname inspection (/dashboard/*) to suppress the duplicate logo and 'Back to Dashboard' button while preserving the standalone /coverletter header card is accepted.

3. Interactive ATS Match Meter & Keyword Insertion:
   - Three-tier coloring (>=80 emerald, 60-79 amber, <60 red) and 1-click missing keyword insertion/copy elevates the feature to a true 10/10 candidate tool.

4. Quality Gates & System Invariants:
   - Live stack E2E via playwright.dir014.config.js (workers: 1, live :3000, zero API mocks).
   - Invariant INV-1 (git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js == 0 bytes) strictly preserved.
   - Vite build < 4.0s, ESLint 0 errors.

You are authorized to begin implementation immediately. Proceed with Step 1 and emit regular heartbeats.
